citation.short_title: Melvin-Koushki, The New Brethren of Purity (2025)

content: The paper says Ibn Turka was the most prominent member of the Turka family of Isfahani scholars and judges, from whom he inherited the position of Shāfiʿī chief judge of Isfahan and Yazd; the family name commemorates origins in Khujand, and his grandfather was Ṣadr al-Dīn Abū Ḥāmid Muḥammad Turka.
